title.zh: 字节揪出DeepSeek-V4隐藏盲区：代码没变，答案却周期性出错
title.en: 字节揪出DeepSeek-V4隐藏盲区：代码没变，答案却周期性出错

current_state.zh: ByteDance Seed researchers showed that DeepSeek-V4's chunked KV cache compression creates periodic 'phase sensitivity' in long-context retrieval, causing answers to flip between correct and incorrect depending on token position, with up to 40.2 percentage points of position-dependent accuracy variation at ~128K tokens.
